title: H3248 (122nd General Assembly): Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2016-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/3248_20161215.htm (LegiScan doc 1440092))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2016-12-15. Struck: college, university, technical college and post-secondary institution from the sentence exempting permit holders whose weapon stays locked in a vehicle; replaced by a broader exemption for post-secondary property.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): (A) It is unlawful for a person to possess a firearm of any kind on any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a private or public school, college, university, technical college, other post-secondary institution, or in any publicly owned building, without the express permission of the authorities in charge of the premises or property.
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): Except as provided in Section 23-31-215(M), the provisions of this subsection related to any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a college, university, technical college, or other post-secondary institution do not apply to a person who is authorized to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to Article 4, Chapter 31, Title 23.
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): The governing body of a college, university, technical college, or other post-secondary institution shall develop policies to implement the provisions contained in this subsection.
